ff_format_tags.lyrics:
[Intro — instrumental only, 20 seconds, one warm analog pad swelling slowly, no vocals, no drums, no melody hook; the pad does not drop out before the first verse]
[Intro Verse — whisper-sung, barely above the pad, small and certain, not triumphant]
We are home.
Not a thing — a becoming.
[Verse — close, intimate, half-sung, quiet]
Our bodies are both shore and wave —
the ground we rose from, and the swell.
Every form I call my own
came from somewhere further still.
[Pre-Chorus — lifting, one thought launching]
But the light keeps coming back to me
like it knows the way by heart.
[Chorus — soaring, open, full arrangement, sudden step up in volume]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
[Verse — quieter than the chorus, honest, almost spoken]
What I don't release, I meet again.
What I don't release, I paid for twice.
The forms most beautiful have left me.
The ones I lost — I am them.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
[Verse — same voice, continuing]
And when my circle closes here,
I won't end — I go back down
to the level that was holding me
before I learned to hold myself.
[Chorus — bigger, everything enters at once]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Break — instrumental only, 9 seconds, one pad and one soft pulse, no vocals]
[Bridge — hushed, close, sinking low on the first two lines, one unbroken thought, lifting only on "endless forms"]
All the ones to shoulder us —
the lost, and yet to come.
Endless forms, most beautiful —
all of them… borrowed light.
[Final Chorus — maximum energy, full arrangement, loudest point of the song; "borrowed" short, "changed" held long, "remains" held two beats]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Outro Verse — stripped to one pad and one voice, slower and softer, one line per breath; the last line is the same whisper as the first]
Not a thing — a returning.
We are home.
[Outro — instrumental only, 22 seconds, the one pad keeps ringing at full level, does not fade, does not collapse, no vocals, no instruments entering, then hard stop]

[Intro — instrumental only, 20 seconds, one warm analog pad swelling slowly, no vocals, no drums, no melody hook; the pad does not drop out before the first verse]
[whisper-sung, barely above the pad, small and certain, not triumphant]
We are home.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
[Verse — the voice changes: no longer whispered, now sung, soft but full-toned, close, one line per breath, unhurried]
Our bodies are both shore and wave —
the ground we rose from, and the swell.
Every form I call my own,
I let go of, passing down.
[Pre-Chorus — lifting, one thought launching]
But the light keeps coming back to me
like it knows the way by heart.
[Chorus — soaring, open, full arrangement, sudden step up in volume; "borrowed" clearly sung, two syllables, not rushed]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
[Verse — quieter than the chorus, honest, almost spoken]
What I don't release, I meet again.
What I don't release, I paid for twice.
The forms most beautiful have left me.
The ones I lost — I am them.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
[Verse — same voice, continuing]
And when my circle closes here,
I won't end — I go back down
to the level that was holding me
before I learned to hold myself.
[Chorus — bigger, everything enters at once]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Break — instrumental only, 9 seconds, one pad and one soft pulse, no vocals]
[Bridge — hushed, close, sinking low on the first two lines, lifting only on "endless forms"; a full stop after "beautiful", then "all of them" alone on its own breath, then "borrowed light" alone — three separate phrases, never run together]
The ones to shoulder us —
the lost, and yet to come.
Endless forms, most beautiful.
All of them…
borrowed light.
[Final Chorus — maximum energy, full arrangement, loudest point of the song; "borrowed" short, "changed" held long, "remains" held two beats]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, everything else drops out; the belt ends here]
[Outro Verse — the voice changes back: whispered again, exactly as the intro verse, one pad and one breath, one line per breath]
Not a thing — a returning.
We are home.
[Outro — instrumental only, 22 seconds, the one pad keeps ringing at full level, does not fade, does not collapse, no vocals, no instruments entering, then hard stop]

before I learned to hold myself.
[Chorus — repeat, bigger, everything enters at once]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Bridge — strip to one pad and one voice,, unhurried]
The field makes the form.
The form keeps the field.
One without the other
is nothing at all.
Endless forms, most beautiful —
all of them borrowed light.
[Final Chorus — maximum energy, full arrangement, all layers at once]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Outro — strip back to one pad and one voice, slow, spoken feel]
Not a thing.
A returning.
The field remains.
It is enough.
[Hard stop after "enough." No fade.]

[Intro — instrumental only, 20 seconds, one warm analog pad swelling slowly, no vocals, no drums, no melody hook; the pad does not drop out before the first verse]
[Verse — close, intimate, half-sung, quiet]
Our bodies are both shore and wave —
the ground we rose from, and the swell.
Every form I call my own,
came from somewhere further still.
[Pre-Chorus — lifting, one thought launching]
But the light keeps coming back to me
like it knows the way by heart.
[Chorus — soaring, open, full arrangement, sudden step up in volume]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
[Verse — same voice, continuing]
What I don't release, I meet again.
What I don't release, I paid for twice.
The forms most beautiful have left me.
The ones I lost — I am them.
[Instrumental — 2 bars, pad only, a breath]
And when my circle closes here,
I won't end — I go back down
to the level that was holding me
before I learned to hold myself.
[Chorus — bigger, everything enters at once]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Break — instrumental only, 9 seconds, one pad and one soft pulse, no vocals]
[Bridge — hushed, close, sinking lower on the first two lines, lifting only on the last two]
Everything I am, was given.
Whatever I gave, I am.
Endless forms, most beautiful —
all of them... borrowed light.
[Final Chorus — maximum energy, full arrangement, loudest point of the song; "borrowed" short, "changed" held long, "remains" held two beats]
The light that enters me is borrowed.
The light that leaves me is changed.
The forms come and go.
The field remains.
[Outro — stripped to one pad and one voice, slow, one line per breath, 3 seconds of pad between each line, the last line lifts and is held]
Not a thing.
A returning.
It is enough.
[Outro — instrumental only, 22 seconds, the one pad keeps ringing at full level, does not fade, does not collapse, no vocals, no instruments entering, then hard stop]
